
```jsx
import { CxButtonGroup } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxButtonGroup from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/button-group/CxButtonGroup'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the base component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **size** | Size the component small or large. | `'small'` \| `'large'` \| `undefined` | - |
| **vertical** | Create a set of buttons that appear vertically stacked rather than horizontally. Split button dropdowns are not supported here. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
